verdict.rationale: ROS 2 documents on-robot capture of sensor and telemetry data: `ros2 bag` records and plays back topics, and a Python API writes bags from your own node. A long-time user also confirms data bagging comes 'for free'. Nothing in the evidence shows cloud upload or sync, and the QoS policies only tune node-to-node DDS transport, which is an adjacent control rather than bandwidth-aware cloud sync. Missing for 10: cloud sync/upload of recorded data, bandwidth-aware or prioritized sync policies, independent hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end robot-to-cloud pipeline.
